title: BITMAX launches crypto-asset lending
description: LVC Corporation announced the start of BITMAX's crypto-asset lending service on 2020-10-07, with users lending crypto assets to BITMAX and receiving lending fees.
notes: Issuer-distributed launch authority. Published campaign rates are product terms, not verified realized returns.

title: LINE BITMAX service ends
description: LINE Xenesis / LY Corporation announced the overall LINE BITMAX service would end on 2026-06-01. The shutdown plan stopped new lending applications and ended existing lending contracts sequentially as part of the closure process.
notes: The platform shutdown date is not asserted as the exact termination date of every individual lending contract.
